# Baan OuadChum Coastal Treehouse

> A 10-room treehouse resort, cafe, and community space by the sea in Pathio, Chumphon, Thailand. Guests can relax in treehouse rooms, join workshops, and experience a holistic community built around five core dimensions: habitat, health, education, occupation, and society.

Baan OuadChum (บ้านอวดชุม) blends sustainable tourism with local community livelihoods. It offers coastal treehouse accommodation, a cafe/restaurant, hands-on workshops, and articles about its philosophy and design.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ouadchum.com/index.html): Overview, philosophy, treehouse room listings, and booking/contact information.
- [Workshop](https://ouadchum.com/workshop.html): Hands-on community workshops (honey, palm sugar, seafood, cacao, flower crafts).
- [Menu](https://ouadchum.com/menu.html): Cafe and restaurant menu.
- [Articles](https://ouadchum.com/articles.html): Stories and design inspiration behind Baan OuadChum.
- [News](https://ouadchum.com/news.html): Press coverage and news mentions.
